title: Close adaptive-runtime evidence-integrity gaps
summary: Implement REQ-QUIC-CRT-0214 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0217 as additive offline evidence contracts, validation, materialization, projection, fixtures, and trace proof while preserving all v1 and v2 artifacts.
planned_changes: Resolve outcomes and retention from the behavior catalog; add exact release joins; introduce structured composite operation and classification target identities; publish a closed classification compatibility catalog; use composite identities in both materializations and accounting; validate and join every immutable projection input; recompute supplied materializations before projection; add deterministic valid and invalid fixtures; and close direct trace evidence.
verification_plan: Run the foundation, plan compiler and manifest, runtime-evidence, hardening, and closeout regressions; validate all additive schemas and catalogs; prove catalog mapping changes and ambiguity; exhaustively test the classification matrix; prove composite identity collision resistance and authoritative release ordering; reject self-hashed unrelated projection inputs; rebuild materializations and projection byte-for-byte; build Incursa.Quic and Incursa.Quic.Tests in Release; run focused requirement-home tests; validate touched SpecTrace artifacts directly; and run git diff --check.
out_of_scope: ProtocolLab, large matrices, transforms, normalization, curation, splits, threshold derivation, or ML
CI changes, active_internal, production activation, or push
